info.title: API.SH: Screwfix
info.description: The Screwfix API from API.SH: public Screwfix data as clean JSON. Every endpoint is a GET with query parameters and your key in the x-api-key header. Calls that run cost the credits shown (x-credits): successes, and lookups that found nothing (404). Refused calls and errors on our side are free. Docs: https://api.sh/docs · Every platform: https://api.sh/openapi.json

tags.name: Account
tags.description: Your balance, usage, logs and past responses. Free.

get.summary: Balance, plan, spend and spend limits
get.description: Credits by bucket (free monthly, plan, pay-as-you-go), the plan, credits spent today and this month (UTC), your spend limits and the key used. Free: costs no credits.

get.description: Calls, errors and credits per UTC day, and the top endpoints by credits. Free. Add output=csv for the daily rows as CSV.

401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

get.summary: Your calls of the last 30 days
get.description: Newest first. Filter by status, route prefix, key or time; page with `before` (the `next` value). Add output=csv|ndjson to download (up to 5,000 rows per request; the next cursor is in the x-next-cursor header). Free.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Only calls made with this key id.

get.summary: Fetch a past response again, free
get.description: The exact response a call returned, for 30 days after the call, at no cost. Use the call's x-request-id. Supports output=csv|ndjson.

200.description: The stored response (headers: x-refetch: 1, x-original-time, x-original-route).

404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

get.description:
The products of one Screwfix category page with the same fields, filters, sort and paging as search. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. A department landing page (a search like "screws") answers `landing_page: true` with its sub-categories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screwfix-category

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Category id (e.g. cat9260006, from `filters` or breadcrumbs) or a screwfix.com /c/... link.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filters as id:value pairs from `filters`, several comma-separated.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
One Screwfix product: code, name, brand, price inc and ex VAT, was price and saving, overview, key features, every technical specification, all images, downloads (manuals, data sheets), badge, current promotion text, category and breadcrumbs, delivery and click-and-collect availability.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screwfix-product

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Product code (e.g. 2503X, `id` in search) or a screwfix.com /p/... link.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.summary: Screwfix store stock for a product
get.description:
Stock of one product in the stores nearest a UK postcode (or a point): for each store its branch code, name, link, address, coordinates, opening hours, distance and drive time, the number in stock, the availability status, the collection date and type (today or next day) and the fulfilment options.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screwfix-product-stock

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Screwfix product code like 2503X, or a product link.

parameters.name: postcode
parameters.description: A UK postcode or outward code (or give lat and long).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer questions about one product, each with its answers (text, date, nickname, brand-answer and best-answer flags, helpful votes, photos). Sort by date, most answered or helpfulness; only answered questions or questions containing words. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screwfix-questions

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Screwfix product code like 2503X, or a product link.

parameters.name: answered
parameters.description: Only questions with at least one answer.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Customer reviews of one product with the rating summary (average, count, distribution, recommended count): rating, title, text, date, reviewer nickname and location, recommended flag, helpful votes, verified-purchaser and other badges, photos and the shop's replies. Filter by star rating, photos or words; sort by relevance, date, rating or helpfulness. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screwfix-reviews

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: A Screwfix product code like 2503X, or a product link.

parameters.name: rating
parameters.description: Only reviews with this many stars (1-5).

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

get.description:
Products on Screwfix for a search, 20 per page: product code, name, link, brand, price inc and ex VAT, was price and saving, rating and review count, category, key features, badge, delivery and click-and-collect flags and image; plus the total, the breadcrumbs and every filter of the page with its values and counts (category, brand, price and each product type's attributes). Filter with the ids in `filters`; sort by relevance, price, brand or rating. Listings marked `sponsored` are the site's ads. Pass `next_page` back as `page`; null on the last page. A department landing page (a search like "screws") answers `landing_page: true` with its sub-categories.

Every response includes `credits_used`: the credits this call cost.

Price: 1 credit per successful call. Docs: https://api.sh/docs/screwfix-search

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Search words or a product code.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description: Filters as id:value pairs from `filters` (id and value), several comma-separated, e.g. category:cat9260006.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number, 1 for the first. Pass back `next_page`.

200.description: The data as JSON (or CSV / NDJSON with `output`).

apiKey.name: x-api-key
apiKey.description: Create keys at https://app.api.sh/keys. Authorization: Bearer <key> also works.

raw.name: raw
raw.description: 0 leaves out the bulky `raw` source blocks (often 10-30x smaller).

fields.name: fields
fields.description: Comma-separated fields to return, e.g. `posts.id,posts.title`. Call metadata is always included.

fresh.name: fresh
fresh.description: 1 skips the 24-hour cache and fetches live.

output.name: output
output.description: csv or ndjson returns the response's records (its main list, or the object as one row) as CSV or NDJSON instead of JSON.

records.name: records
records.description: With output=csv|ndjson: the top-level list to turn into rows (e.g. `reviews`), or `.` for the whole object as one row.

status_url.description: On a 503 for a paused endpoint: the status page, which lists open incidents.

E400.description: A parameter is missing or invalid. Not charged (unless the call ran and the source rejected the value; credits_used says).

E401.description: Missing, invalid, revoked or expired API key. Not charged. See https://api.sh/docs/errors#401

E402.description: Not enough credits, a spend limit you set was reached (`spend_limit`), or the key's monthly credit cap was reached (`key_cap`). Not charged.

E404.description: Not found, or not public. A lookup that ran costs the endpoint's price (credits_used says); an unknown route is free.

E502.description: The source site failed this time; retry. Not charged.

E503.description: Endpoint paused or temporarily unavailable; may include retry-after, and status_url (https://api.sh/status) for a paused endpoint. Not charged.
